data.statement: Add global, theme-independent font-size steps for the UI: two settings ui_font_size_step and text_font_size_step, each with 7 named steps (extra_small..huge), applied to control font and text-window font respectively; persisted and validated; migrated from legacy ui_text_scale. Theme keeps colors + font family only.

acceptance: config defines 7 UI font-size steps (extra_small, small, medium, normal, large, very_large, huge) with default 'normal'.
ui_state_service resolves each step to base_point_size * its factor (0.80/0.90/0.95/1.00/1.15/1.30/1.50); an unknown step resolves as 'normal' (factor 1.0).
Applying UI settings sets the application font point size to base * ui_font_size_step factor.
The theme stylesheet sizes text-editor windows (QTextEdit/QPlainTextEdit) at base * text_font_size_step factor, independent of the UI step, while control-role editors use the UI step size.
build_default_settings() includes ui_font_size_step and text_font_size_step both equal to 'normal'.
validate_settings repairs a missing/invalid font-size step to 'normal' and maps a legacy ui_text_scale value to the nearest new step.
assumptions: Same 7-step scale is offered for both UI and text fonts; default normal (x1.0).
Theme font/text_font point_size is now driven by the global steps; brand themes already carry point_size None so nothing else fixes size.
data.reason: Additive settings + a contained apply/size-injection change reusing existing font infrastructure; fully unit-testable, reversible, no workflow-domain data. User approved this plan and its decisions.
scope: IN: config font-size step constants; ui_state_service factor map + resolver + apply_theme/apply_ui_settings size injection; settings_service defaults+validation+migration; their unit tests. OUT: Settings page UI redesign (Slice 6); per-page scroll/anti-truncation (Slice 7); sidebar/min-resolution (Slice 8).
data.source: User chat: implement global font-size steps (7 steps), separate UI-controls vs text-window font, simplified Settings; keep controls visible. This slice = service/config/persistence model only (Slice 5).
data.understanding: Add two theme-independent settings ui_font_size_step and text_font_size_step, each one of 7 named steps (extra_small 0.80, small 0.90, medium 0.95, normal 1.00, large 1.15, very_large 1.30, huge 1.50; default normal). In apply_theme, compute ui_point = base*ui_factor and text_point = base*text_factor, inject them into the normalized theme font.point_size / text_font.point_size, set the app font to ui_point, and build the stylesheet so text editors use text_point while control-role editors use ui_point. apply_ui_settings reads both steps from settings and passes them. settings_service defaults both to normal, repairs invalid to normal, and migrates a legacy ui_text_scale value to the nearest step. Theme keeps colors + font family only. No Settings UI in this slice.

data.rationale: Operators need discrete font-size steps to adapt the UI to monitor resolution and eyesight.
data.requirement: The configuration shall define seven named UI font-size steps in ascending order (extra_small, small, medium, normal, large, very_large, huge) with 'normal' as the default step.

data.summary: Green: step factors + resolve; unknown->normal.

data.rationale: The scale must be deterministic and safe against invalid input.
data.requirement: ui_state_service shall resolve a font-size step to the base font point size multiplied by its factor (extra_small 0.80, small 0.90, medium 0.95, normal 1.00, large 1.15, very_large 1.30, huge 1.50), treating an unknown step as 'normal'.

data.summary: Green: app font scales by ui step.

data.rationale: The interface (labels, buttons, controls) must scale with the chosen UI step.
data.requirement: Applying UI settings shall set the running application font point size to the base font point size multiplied by the ui_font_size_step factor.

data.summary: Green: text-editor size = base*text step, control-role = ui step.

data.rationale: Reading/editing text windows should be sizable separately from the compact interface controls.
data.requirement: The theme stylesheet shall size text-editor windows (QTextEdit/QPlainTextEdit) at the base font point size multiplied by the text_font_size_step factor, independent of the ui_font_size_step, while control-role editors use the ui_font_size_step size.

data.summary: Green: default settings include both steps=normal.

data.rationale: New installs must persist valid default font-size steps.
data.requirement: build_default_settings shall include ui_font_size_step and text_font_size_step, both defaulting to 'normal'.

data.summary: Green: validate repairs invalid + migrates ui_text_scale.

data.rationale: Persisted settings must self-heal and migrate the deprecated global text-scale into the new step model.
data.requirement: validate_settings shall repair a missing or invalid ui_font_size_step or text_font_size_step to 'normal' and shall map a legacy 'ui_text_scale' value to the nearest supported font-size step.
